window-1.title: Koalas to the Max
window-1.blurb: Drag to split one big dot into thousands until a hidden picture emerges — and then feed it your own image so your friends have to slowly unpick a photo of your grandma, dot by dot.

window-4.title: A Clinton Hill Brownstone with Chinese Inflections by Bespoke Only
window-4.blurb: It's 19th-century Shanghai smuggled into a Brooklyn brownstone — proof you can build heritage into a room as texture and mood instead of hanging it on the wall like a souvenir.

window-5.title: Elijah Pies Joo Chiat (new flagship)
window-5.blurb: A snow crab laksa pie is exactly the kind of heritage-meets-nonsense mashup you'd invent yourself, so go eat one in Joo Chiat before someone else claims the idea.
